formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P14 — Prospective Reconstructor-Frequency-Band Composition Coordinate Confirmation, Method×Era-Balanced Fresh80 Reconstruction Acquisition, Dominant↔Nondominant Q5 R1 Residual Sign Separation, Within-Era Gap Transport, Method-Invariance Challenge, Reconstructor×Era Interaction Rival, Composition-Cancellation Reconstitution & Independent Coordinate Confirmation Campaign

sampling_design.exclude: all prior body-contacted source IDs: legacy60 + P11 fresh40 + P13 original80 + P13 three replay-repair replacements = 183 unique IDs
sampling_design.method_definition: CFOP if frozen method_raw upper == CFOP, otherwise NONCFOP
sampling_design.dominant_reconstructor_definition: raw reconstructor frequency >=200 in frozen 10,591 population
sampling_design.within_cell_selection: deterministic SHA-256 rank under fixed seed
sampling_design.batch_assignment: 8 batches ×10; selected rows spread across batches with round-dependent rotation so no 16-cell is batch-pure

acquisition.replacement_policy: only pre-geometry replay-invalid replacement by separately sealed amendment preserving method×reconstructor-band×era cell and batch

fixed_analysis.structural_adjustment: R1 hard caliper on 2x2 action-opportunity TV distance <=1 action-mass unit

reconstructor_band_sign_separation.rule: dominant mean > 0 AND nondominant mean < 0 AND dominant-minus-nondominant gap >= 1/18

method_invariant_band_direction.rule: within both CFOP and NONCFOP, dominant-minus-nondominant gap > 0; at least one method gap >=1/18 and both method gaps >=1/36

within_era_band_transport.rule: among four eras, dominant-minus-nondominant gap >0 in at least 3 eras and gap >=1/18 in at least 2 eras

terminal_adjudication.NOT_CONFIRMED: zero or one primary prediction passes
terminal_adjudication.SUPPORT_LIMITED: any primary prediction cannot be evaluated because frozen support floor is not met

forbidden: use D1 fresh80 in the fresh P14 terminal verdict
let the interaction rival rescue a failed primary coordinate
inference_boundary: Reconstructor frequency is a corpus/composition coordinate, not a property of the solver's cognitive state.
Confirmation would establish transport of a descriptive composition coordinate only.
No causal mediation or human planning mechanism promotion is authorized.
